explication: Awesome OSINT For Everything is a curated, single-file directory rather than an executable application. The principal workflow is: a reader browses the README index, selects an intelligence domain, follows a listed external resource, and uses that service to produce investigative findings. The graph preserves the README’s major capability families, including breach discovery, identity and social research, technical reconnaissance, media/file analysis, geographic and physical intelligence, and specialized records. No runtime source beyond README.md was sampled; package scripts and link-check infrastructure are excluded.
